en: Color postcard showing a row of historic half-timbered and gabled houses with steep red-tiled roofs. The main foreground building is a large, irregular medieval house with exposed timber framing on the upper parts and plastered walls, small rectangular windows, and wooden shutters. Adjacent buildings feature stepped gables typical of late medieval or Renaissance urban architecture. The scene is taken on a sunny day with a blue sky and scattered clouds; no visible modern cars or signage appear in the image.
